'''Iskaayuma''' was the capital of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], located on the [[Sika Peninsula/Legends|Sika Peninsula]] on the continent of [[Encheeko/Legends|Encheeko]]. 

The residential area is built around the [[Chattza Bay]] while the industrial areas are more inland. Iskaayuma was a sprawling city with omnipresent thick smog from the hundreds of weapons factories.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

==History==
Iskaayuma grew from the [[Chattza Enclave]] absorbing nearby enclaves, towns, and expanding into the jungle until it became the planet's second largest city (after [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]]). As the city grew, so did the enclave. The [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] completely dominated Iskaayuma.<ref name="guide" /> 

Following Navik's rise to power, he moved the capital to Iskaayuma. By keeping the seat of power in his home city, Navik strengthened his position by removing the "corrupting" influence of Equator City. Navik also sought to refocus Rodian views on the importance of the hunt, and Iskaayuma had been home to the [[Eanca Goa-Ato|Grand Protector's Guild Hall]] for generations.<ref name="guide" /> 

Industry and government were the primary employers.<ref name="guide" /> The [[Rodmark Weapons Plant/Legends|Rodmark Weapons Plant]] was a factory in the industrial zone of the city.<ref name="Street Drama">{{WEGCite|story=Street Drama|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}} </ref> [[Iskaayuma Starport]] was the [[Rodian Home Fleet]] Headquarters and primary staging area. Iskaayuma also housed most of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] services on the planet.<ref name="guide" /> 

Interstellar travelers were encouraged to land at Equator City, unless they had specific business in Iskaayuma. Navik maintained near martial law over Iskaayuma and most visitors felt unwelcome in the city, especially with the ever present, armor-clad [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]]. Tourists only came to visit the great Guild Hall or attend the occasional home performances of the [[Rodian Galactic Drama Troupe]].<ref name="guide" />
